label_policy.majority: strictly more than half of allocated judge seats
label_policy.schedule_selection: greedy unseen-video coverage then low scene exposure, fixed 108 pairs; cycle if fewer common valid pairs
label_policy.weight_mapping: raw reliability divided by fixed schedule mean; T5 permutes schedule weights
label_policy.audit_status: latest verdict; missing or conflicting claims unresolved

scope_notes: Small pilot with 27 optimizer updates per run, not convergence training.
Main student comparison uses common valid labels. Each method full teacher output retained; separate full-output student runs are extensions.
Teacher compute/observation matching and T4/recursion ablations remain separate extensions; no independent recursion-effect claim from main comparison.
Single teacher-label realization; three seeds vary student initialization of LoRA/order/sampling.
Tests use 224px, 8 global frames plus16 consecutive native-rate local frames; quality outside this observation budget is unmeasured.
